name: Veroca Joyas
description: Uruguayan online jewelry store selling silver and gold-plated rings, earrings, chains, pendants, bracelets and wedding bands, plus traditional silverwork and gift cards. Delivers in Montevideo and the interior.
description_es: Joyería en línea uruguaya con anillos, caravanas, cadenas, colgantes, pulseras y alianzas en plata y baño de oro, además de platería criolla y gift cards. Envía en Montevideo y al interior.

ships_to.notes: Up to 3 business days in Montevideo and 4 in the interior, home delivery only in the interior, per the store's shipping page

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the Carrasco store (Av. Arocena), ready 24 hours after purchase, per the shipping page

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Fenicio platform; product search is verified by the probe. The home page banner and the shipping page state different free-shipping thresholds.

sources.supports: Shipping: Montevideo and interior delivery times, pickup at Carrasco store
Home page: product range, delivery banner
